_comment: Round elements. 'plain' must be first (id 0). 'damage' is the kind of harm it does to ghosts (fire, wind, lightning); rounds without it count as an ordinary bullet. Effects read these numbers; no balance values live in code.

elements.name: wind
elements._comment: It bursts where it lands: loose things within volumeRadius are shoved (gustImpulse), and every player within blastRadius m is thrown away from the hit at up to blastKnockback m/s (nearly all of it close to, about half at the edge), whoever fired it. Fire it at the ground by your feet to be thrown into the air.

elements.name: haze
elements._comment: Ethereal: passes through everything physical, as if fired underwater. It slows from muzzle speed to fadeSpeed within about 10 m (raise dragPerMetre for less range), then fades. Stealthy: ghosts cannot see it coming. It goes through players too, and takes a little from them (player.json: etherealScale).

elements.name: voodoo
elements._comment: The bullet hits the one who fired it, at once. Will deal damage once there is health.

elements.name: tailwind
elements._comment: Wind + voodoo, cast on the shooter: faster for a while.

elements.name: shroud
elements._comment: Haze + voodoo, cast on the shooter: ghosts cannot see you for a while.

elements.name: blink
elements._comment: Lightning + voodoo: teleports the shooter along the line of fire, stopping short of anything solid. afterglow: seconds the lightning lingers on you.

elements.name: fog
elements._comment: Haze + wind: bursts into a dome of fog where it hits (volumeRadius wide, fog.height tall). Bullets tear tunnels (bulletHole m, closing over holeLife s), blasts clear spheres (closing over blastHoleLife s), lightning charges it for electrifyTime s.

elements.name: ghostfire
elements._comment: Fire + haze: no bullet. A cone of ghost fire bursts from the muzzle (range m, halfAngle degrees, lasting duration s). Ethereal: walls do not stop it. It burns the supernatural, and players only a little (player.json: ghostfirePerSecond).

elements.name: firelight
elements._comment: Fire + voodoo, cast on the shooter: a pulse of fire runs out along the ground (range m, at speed m/s) and marks where each ghost was as it passes, for duration s, seen through walls.

elements.name: steam
elements._comment: Not a round: what fire and fog make when they meet in the world. The whole cloud flashes to steam. radiusScale: blast radius as a multiple of the cloud's; impulse: shove, m/s at the centre; ghostDamage: in rounds of fire damage; playerDamage: fraction of health at the centre; lifetime: seconds the steam takes to clear. All scaled by how much fog was left.
